task.description:
Step Final (git-merge) — Complete the WF-03 workflow by merging the feature branch to main.

Workflow:
1. Ensure on feature branch:
   - git branch --show-current (must be feature/WF03-gh391-20260801)
   - git status (must be clean working tree)

2. Create or verify GitHub pull request:
   - If PR not yet created:
     gh pr create --base main --title "fix(ISS-0125): ON DELETE CASCADE FK constraint for instance_definition_snapshots" --body "GitHub issue: #391\n\nFixes C23503 errors in integration test runs caused by FK constraint ordering issue. Migration adds ON DELETE CASCADE to instance_definition_snapshots.definition_id FK.\n\nResolves: #391"
   - If PR already created (use gh pr list), verify it is open

3. Verify GitHub Actions checks pass:
   - gh pr checks (all should be PASS)
   - If any check fails: do NOT merge; report FAIL with issue

4. Merge to main:
   - gh pr merge --squash --delete-branch (--squash creates single clean commit; --delete-branch removes remote branch atomically)
   - This will close the PR and delete the branch from GitHub

5. Return to main and verify clean state:
   - git checkout main
   - git pull --ff-only origin main (fast-forward only; will fail if conflicts exist)
   - git branch --show-current (must output: main)
   - git status (must show clean working tree)
   - git log --oneline -3 (should show the squash-merge commit on main)

6. Clean up any remaining local-only files:
   - If any .py/.ps1/.log files exist outside src/, tests/, web/, docs/, migrations/: move to scratch/ or delete
   - Final git status must be absolutely clean

Return PASS only when:
- All above steps completed successfully
- Feature branch is deleted from GitHub
- Repo is on main with clean working tree
- Merge commit is visible on main branch

Return FAIL if:
- Merge conflicts cannot be resolved
- GitHub checks fail and are not fixable here
- PR merge was blocked
acceptance_criteria: GitHub PR created (or existing PR verified open)
Feature branch merged to main via --squash
Remote branch deleted (feature/WF03-gh391-20260801 gone from GitHub)
Local repo on main with clean working tree

result.summary: Successfully merged feature branch to main with squash strategy. PR #395 created, reviewed, and merged. Remote branch deleted. Repository is on main with clean working tree. Merge commit: ecc4f2b.
